# Compiler-produced ready-bitmap dispatcher

`kernel.c` is a self-authored, header-free C11 consumer for one ordinary private DWORD bitmap. It intersects pending bits with a runtime allowed mask, returns the lowest eligible bit index, clears only that bit, and returns sentinel 32 without changing pending when no eligible bit remains. The explicit nonzero guard keeps `__builtin_ctz` defined. This is a single-owner bitmap contract, with no atomicity or concurrent-access claim.

Two root-owned discovery builds used the unchanged fixed i686 profile in `p2-compiled-records/build.py`, SHA-256 `fe426f202b48664a87357c766d39099b9d35b5d8217c2b114696164a0d468258`. Their complete source, COFF object, text, and Intel disassembly are byte identical. The source is 309 bytes; the ordinary i386 object is 562 bytes with one external function, no relocations, empty data/BSS, and only 100 bytes of non-code `.debug$S` metadata. The complete sole-function text is 40 bytes, SHA-256 `f720ba26c3c06465c22b0c1b980cc5023f63d721ada20dbb01cef016d8568024`. No compiler output is rewritten.

The observed function contains 18 instructions and four leaders at offsets 0, 16, 32, and 37. Its nonzero branch contains `F3 0F BC C6` at offset 16, disassembled as TZCNT EAX,ESI. Baseline admission refused that instruction and each complete bound profile while admitting the other 17 instructions. The selected engine policy implements exact single-prefix DWORD register/memory TZCNT as software semantics: zero input returns 32, CF reports zero input, ZF reports zero result, undefined arithmetic flags clear, and DF/fixed bit1 remain. This is not a silent BSF alias or a hardware BMI1/CPUID contract.

The permanent producer is the discovery producer with only repository-root depth changed from `parents[3]` to `parents[4]`. Its compiler, flags, environment, ordinary COFF extractor, symbol-only adaptation, complete-object/text preservation, and tool/source stability checks remain unchanged. Root owns the formal reproduction and receipt publication. Routine native and Wasm tests consume retained artifacts without invoking a compiler.

Planned actual verification uses replacement/resident owners with explicit/entry captures. Direct register self-alias probes cover zero and all 32 one-hot inputs. Memory probes use an EAX destination that aliases the effective-address base, four distinct values, and one ReadPermission fault repaired only by protection. They check exact zero/FLAGS behavior because the original guards zero and later overwrites count flags.

A separate self-authored 64-byte cdecl caller invokes the complete original three times on pending `80000128` with allowed mask `28`. Natural returns 3, 5, and 32 are packed by guest instructions into `00030520`, while disallowed bits remain `80000100`. One initial CPU/RAM seed precedes four budgeted runs; no upload, reseed, remap, or recapture occurs between them. ESI/EDI are naturally saved and restored. Runtime assertions cover the complete 4364-byte arena and valid dirty FP state; persisted milestones and selected 64-byte data/stack checks have finite scope, not a whole-memory claim. Observed execution results belong to the result/evidence bank rather than edits to this source after execution.

This fixture proves one finite software count operation and guarded bitmap consumer. It does not prove general REP/BMI1/SIMD support, hardware feature detection, concurrency, performance, whole-compiler coverage, or application/game/browser compatibility.
